I've added a "Who paid" section and a "Settle up" section. The transfers also appear in the copied summary, after a new "Paid:" list.

Who paid: type an amount next to each person who paid, or press "Paid all" to put the whole bill on one person. Under the list, "Paid so far" compares what's entered to the bill total. If they don't match, a message says how much is short or over, e.g. "Payments add up to $40.00, which is $26.00 short of the $66.00 total."
Settle up: once the amounts match, it lists the fewest payments that even everyone out, like "Anna pays Ben $18.00". If nobody owes anything, it says "Everyone is even." Amounts show the currency sign (e.g. "$18.00" rather than "18.00").
Removing a person also removes their payment, so the "short" message reappears until you fix the amounts.
Small layout fix: the items, tax and tip line under each person was cramped on phones, so it now wraps.

What I tested and how:

Automated tests (24, all passing; 9 are new):
Messages for no payers entered, paying too little, and paying too much.
Several payers adding up to the total is accepted.
One payer: everyone else pays them.
Already even: no payments needed.
A four-person case is settled in the fewest possible payments.
Every suggested payment leaves each person at exactly zero.
The copied summary includes the settle-up lines.
Real browser, run at 1280px and 375px wide, with Anna, Ben and Cleo, a $60 dinner and a 10% tip ($66.00 total):
Messages: the "enter who paid" prompt appears first; a negative amount shows "Price can't be negative."; $40 shows "$26.00 short"; adding $30 from Cleo shows "$4.00 more than".
Settle up: with Ben $40 and Cleo $26, it shows "Anna pays Ben $18.00" and "Anna pays Cleo $4.00".
Paid all: for Anna, it shows Ben and Cleo each paying her $22.00.
Copy summary: I read the clipboard back and it contains the payers and the transfers.
Reload: after a reload, the payments and transfers are still there.
Equal payments: $22 each shows "Everyone is even."
Removing Cleo brings back the "short" message.
Mobile: nothing scrolls sideways at either width, and I looked over a screenshot of the phone layout.
